name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: A friend's title now plays only from that friend when it converts for you: one play is never split between their server and yours, and one failed title no longer switches every title from that friend over to your server for two minutes. If the friend is at its limit or can't play a title, the player shows that, instead of your server stepping in halfway. Your server still converts a friend's titles when the friend has switched converting off or runs an older version.
